DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)

The absence of maternal infection, metabolic abnormalities, cocaine use, or placental pathology, combined with your clinical signs of seizures, lethargy, hypotonia, irregular respirations, and a tense fontanelle, strongly points to HIE from an intrapartum hypoxic event. I will proceed with a brain MRI to confirm the diagnosis and assess for acute injury.
